science.qualification: Photosphere color from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)), dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 9,460 K and log g 3.57 (u1 0.250, u2 0.325): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting. The surface is darkened by latitude from the published Roche fit of Bailey et al. (2024), ApJ 972, 103: the hot poles brighter and bluer, the cool equator dimmer and redder.

offLimbContext.source: none: no observation, a transparent plate

limbMaterial.composition: black alpha darkens the photosphere according to the selected quadratic limb-darkening law; transparent outside the silhouette
